description: How to move an affiliate program to LinkJolt from Rewardful, Tolt, FirstPromoter or Affonso, or from anything else by CSV: the page where the person pastes their old tool's API key, and what happens after (LinkJolt fills in the campaign, imports the affiliates with their old links still working, gives one prompt for their coding tool, and emails the affiliates). Never ask for or accept an API key in the chat: the person pastes it on that page. Needs no LinkJolt account to call.

from.description: The affiliate tool the program runs on today; other for anything else (a CSV).

name: switch_from_another_tool
title: Switch from another affiliate tool
